why: All three checks confirm the finding. (1) Doc: curl -sL https://code.claude.com/docs/en/best-practices.md line 482 carries the quoted sentence VERBATIM and the whole line is exactly that sentence -- 'The first command prints plain text. The `json` format returns a single JSON object with a `result` field. The `stream-json` format prints one JSON object per line, starting with an init event.' Nothing later on the line or in the surrounding block (lines 466-482, the 'Run non-interactive mode' section) qualifies or reverses it. `best-practices` is row 63 of scripts/claude-doc-pages.tsv, so it is a valid Claude contract page. (2) Code: apps/cli/src/index.ts:457 sets `const streamJson = args.outputFormat === 'stream-json'`, and inside the `client.on('session:event', ...)` subscription at :465-471 the only stream-json write is `if (streamJson) { process.stdout.write(JSON.stringify(ev) + '\n') }` -- a raw passthrough of the server's `session:event` payload with no framing object. Cited line 468 is the blank line; the actual write is :469-471, so the 468-471 range is right. (3) Consequence verified separately from the identifier: nothing writes an init frame one layer up either -- both callers of `sendAndStream` (cmdSend at :591, the self-contained `run` path at :852) reach it with no prior stdout write; the run path's only pre-turn output is stderr (`Project selected: ...` at :838). Absence checks used grep -a (NUL-byte trap): `grep -an "init|subtype|system" apps/cli/src/index.ts` returns only `system:versions`/`system:homeDir` RPC channel names and no init/subtype token; `grep -rna "'init'|\"init\"|type: 'system'|subtype" apps/cli/src packages/core/src` finds no init framing (only two prose comments about the structured-output result subtype in packages/core/src/types/message.ts). The only repo hits for `--output-format stream-json` outside apps/cli are inside vendored bundles (packages/pi-agent-server/dist/index.js:344803 and the electron resource copies), which is Claude's own CLI being *consumed* as a subprocess, not our output -- no sibling subsystem emits the init frame either. Not an owner decision: none of the nine dated decisions in docs/superpowers/specs/2026-07-29-inert-worklist.md section 3 (SEATBELT_TESTING_WILDCARD, availableModels/enforceAvailableModels, autoMode.classifyAllShell, ManagedDeliveryStateV1.drops, plugins/hooks-runtime.ts, SdkMcpServerConfig.required, SessionMirrorStore.delete, MirrorSessionKey.subpath/listSubkeys, listSessionSummaries/listSessions) touches headless output framing. Not a de-brand or dropped-subscription difference: `nessy-general-agent run --output-format stream-json` is shipped and documented as a real format in docs/cli.md:165, and the audit already treats the headless surface as a contract surface (the `headless` page verdict says our run command matches --output-format text|json|stream-json and --json-schema 'precisely'). Two caveats that narrow but do not refute it: the trailing clause 'including `mcp_server_errors`' is not supported by THIS page -- that field comes from the changelog/headless pages (f133, f180) -- and f125 is the narrow init-frame subset of the broader f180 stream-shape row, so they should be closed together, not twice.
correctedState: CONFIRMED, with the evidence line corrected to apps/cli/src/index.ts:457 + :469-471 (468 is blank). `nessy-general-agent run|send --output-format stream-json` emits one JSON object per line, but each line is a raw server `session:event` payload (`text_delta`, `text_complete`, `tool_start`, `tool_result`, `complete`, `error`, `typed_error`, `interrupted`) written verbatim by `sendAndStream`; there is no leading `system`/init frame and no terminating `result` frame anywhere in the repo (grep -a for init/subtype/system framing over apps/cli/src and packages/core/src: 0 hits; the only `--output-format stream-json` hits outside apps/cli are vendored Claude-CLI bundles). Nothing is written to stdout before the first server event on either caller path (cmdSend :591, run :852 -- the run path's pre-turn output goes to stderr at :838). Scope note: the `mcp_server_errors` half of the claim belongs to the headless/changelog pages, not best-practices.md, and this row is the init-frame subset of f180.
